{{Quote|Senya Tirall? The Knight-Captain?|Koth Vortena|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" />}}
'''Knight-Captain''' or '''Captain''' was a rank within the [[Knights of Zakuul]], an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] warriors in the [[Eternal Empire]]. Elite Knights such as [[Senya Tirall]] and [[Draynon Atrus]] were Knight-Captains, leading other Knights into battle.
